title: Cleaning the Kitchen
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Clean the school or home kitchen in three kinds: daily (dishes, surfaces, floor, waste), weekly (shelves, store, stove), special (walls, store emptied, after an event). Use soap and hot water; children never mix cleaning chemicals.

skills.key_step: The child names routine kitchen cleaning practices (washing dishes, wiping surfaces, cleaning the stove, sweeping and mopping, emptying waste, keeping raw and cooked food apart, separate cloths) and why each matters.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how to clean different surfaces.
floor.question: How is a wooden table cleaned?
floor.answer: with a damp cloth, then dried

representations: pictures of clean and dirty kitchens
steps: Keep raw and cooked food apart.
Empty waste into a covered bin.

board.do: Write "one cloth for dishes and floor".
Wait for "germs spread to the dishes".

misconceptions.repair: Sort jobs into daily, weekly and special; dishes and surfaces are daily.

misconceptions.ask: How should raw meat be kept from vegetables?
misconceptions.repair: Use separate boards or wash between; raw meat juices carry germs.

misconceptions.ask: What should be done with kitchen waste?
misconceptions.repair: Put waste in a covered bin and empty it daily.

misconceptions.ask: Why use separate cloths for dishes and for the floor?
misconceptions.repair: Ask where the floor cloth has been.

checks.question: Why keep raw meat apart from other food?
checks.answer: its germs can spread to food eaten raw

skills.key_step: The child sorts and orders kitchen cleaning: daily (dishes, surfaces, stove, floor, waste), weekly (shelves, cupboards, store, windows), special (walls, emptying the store), top to bottom, clean to dirty, the right agent for each surface, never mixing chemicals.
steps: Sort the job: daily, weekly or special.
Use the right agent; never mix them.

board.do: Write the cards: wipe shelves, mop floor, clean stove.

misconceptions.ask: Which is cleaned last in a kitchen?
misconceptions.repair: Wipe crumbs off a shelf onto a just-mopped floor.

listen_for: Mixing makes them stronger and better
misconceptions.ask: Why must cleaning agents not be mixed?
misconceptions.repair: Read the warning on a bleach bottle.

misconceptions.ask: What is special cleaning of a food store?
misconceptions.repair: Show weevils and mouse droppings at the back of a store.

listen_for: Leave them wet in the sink
misconceptions.ask: What is done with dish cloths and sponges after washing up?
misconceptions.repair: Smell a sponge left wet for two days.

checks.question: Name a weekly kitchen cleaning job.
checks.answer: cleaning shelves, cupboards or the store

checks.question: Why never mix cleaning agents?
checks.answer: some mixtures give off poisonous gas
